fusions.name: Gizzard Stones
fusions.desc: Coughs up a swallowed stone that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Mudbank Heave
fusions.desc: You heave up out of the mud, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Taking On Ballast
fusions.desc: The damage you take falls by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stone in the Belly
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 12% earth resistance.
